sources.name: Web Coverage Processing Service (WCPS) Language Interface Standard 1.1
verified_facts: A WCPS request is a processCoverages expression over one or more coverages.
WCPS defines null values as coverage range-field values and supports coverage processing beyond simple retrieval.
Aggregate expressions such as minimum and maximum are processing results and must be evaluated over an explicitly valid range domain.
semantic_limits: A successful WCPS aggregate does not prove the provenance, vertical datum or measurement accuracy of the input coverage.
Null or missing cells must not be silently converted to zero or included in parcel min/max calculations.

sources.name: CF Conventions 1.12 Conformance Requirements
verified_facts: CF 1.12 files identify the convention through the global Conventions attribute.
If both missing_value and _FillValue are used, they should have the same value.
The legal values for the vertical positive attribute are up or down.
semantic_limits: CF conformance does not establish that vertical coordinates are Ordnance Datum Newlyn.
Vertical direction, units, datum identity and raster measurement accuracy remain independent checks.

sources.name: Zarr Core Specification Version 3.0
verified_facts: Zarr v3 array metadata requires a fill_value field.
Array data are divided according to a declared chunk grid.
The fill value is data-type dependent and represents the value used for elements without explicitly stored data.
semantic_limits: The existence of a chunk key or chunk grid does not prove that all source pixels are present or spatially valid.
Fill values must be excluded from parcel height extrema unless the source contract explicitly defines them as valid measurements.

sources.name: Gridded Geodetic data eXchange Format (GGXF) 1.0
verified_facts: Packed netCDF variable values are multiplied by scale_factor and then have add_offset applied after reading.
Variables may use their own missing_value attribute.
Encoding and unpacking rules are part of interpreting stored numeric values.
semantic_limits: Stored integer values must not be compared as physical heights before scale and offset are applied.
Correct unpacking does not upgrade LiDAR source accuracy or prove parcel-polygon binding.
